name: transmembrane phosphoinositide 3-phosphatase and tensin homolog 2

function.text: TPTE2 is the approved symbol for transmembrane phosphoinositide 3-phosphatase and tensin homolog 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in monoatomic ion channel activity; phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase activity; phosphatidylinositol biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TPTE2 encodes transmembrane phosphoinositide 3-phosphatase and tensin homolog 2. Its functions include monoatomic ion channel activity and phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TPTE2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.
